verses.original: וַיֹּ֨סֶף ע֥וֹד דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ כָּל־ בָּח֥וּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ ‘ō·wḏ dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- kāl- bā·ḥūr bə·yiś·rā·’êl šə·lō·šîm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: David again assembled the chosen men of Israel thirty thousand in all
verses.literalPt: E TORNOU Davi a ajuntar todos os escolhidos de Israel, em número de trinta mil.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם׀ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וְכָל־ הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ מִֽבַּעֲלֵ֖י יְהוּדָ֑ה לְהַעֲל֣וֹת מִשָּׁ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָ֣א שֵׁ֗ם שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת יֹשֵׁ֥ב הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ dā·wiḏ wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’it·tōw mib·ba·‘ă·lê yə·hū·ḏāh lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ miš·šām ’êṯ ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer- niq·rā šêm šêm Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yō·šêḇ hak·kə·ru·ḇîm ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: And he and all his troops - set out for Baale of Judah to bring up from there the ark of God which is called by the Name the name of the LORD of Hosts who is enthroned between the cherubim that are on it
verses.literalPt: E levantou-se Davi, e partiu, com todo o povo que tinha consigo, para Baalim de Judá, para levarem dali para cima a arca de Deus, sobre a qual se invoca o nome, o nome do SENHOR dos Exércitos, que se assenta entre os querubins.

verses.original: וַיַּרְכִּ֜בוּ אֶת־ אֲר֤וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ עֲגָלָ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֔הוּ מִבֵּ֥ית אֲבִינָדָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּגִּבְעָ֑ה וְעֻזָּ֣א וְאַחְי֗וֹ בְּנֵי֙ אֲבִ֣ינָדָ֔ב נֹהֲגִ֖ים אֶת־ הָעֲגָלָ֥ה חֲדָשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar·ki·ḇū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- ‘ă·ḡā·lāh ḥă·ḏā·šāh way·yiś·śā·’u·hū mib·bêṯ ’ă·ḇî·nā·ḏāḇ ’ă·šer bag·giḇ·‘āh wə·‘uz·zā wə·’aḥ·yōw bə·nê ’ă·ḇî·nā·ḏāḇ nō·hă·ḡîm ’eṯ- hā·‘ă·ḡā·lāh ḥă·ḏā·šāh
verses.literal: They set the ark of God on a new cart and brought it from the house of Abinadab which was on the hill Uzzah and Ahio the sons of Abinadab were guiding the new cart
verses.literalPt: E puseram a arca de Deus em um carro novo, e a levaram da casa de Abinadabe, que está em Gibeá; e Uzá e Aiô, filhos de Abinadabe, guiavam o carro novo.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֗הוּ מִבֵּ֤ית אֲבִֽינָדָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּגִּבְעָ֔ה עִ֖ם אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאַחְי֕וֹ הֹלֵ֖ךְ לִפְנֵ֥י הָאָרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā·’u·hū mib·bêṯ ’ă·ḇî·nā·ḏāḇ ’ă·šer bag·giḇ·‘āh ‘im ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’aḥ·yōw hō·lêḵ lip̄·nê hā·’ā·rō·wn
verses.literal: bringing with it the ark of God - - And Ahio was walking in front of the ark
verses.literalPt: E levando-o da casa de Abinadabe, que está em Gibeá, com a arca de Deus, Aiô ia adiante da arca.

verses.original: וְדָוִ֣ד׀ וְכָל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מְשַֽׂחֲקִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל עֲצֵ֣י בְרוֹשִׁ֑ים וּבְכִנֹּר֤וֹת וּבִנְבָלִים֙ וּבְתֻפִּ֔ים וּבִמְנַֽעַנְעִ֖ים וּֽבְצֶלְצֶלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wiḏ wə·ḵāl bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl mə·śa·ḥă·qîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh bə·ḵōl ‘ă·ṣê ḇə·rō·wō·šîm ū·ḇə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ ū·ḇin·ḇā·lîm ū·ḇə·ṯup·pîm ū·ḇim·na·‘an·‘îm ū·ḇə·ṣel·ṣe·lîm
verses.literal: David and all the house of Israel were celebrating before the LORD with all kinds of wood instruments . . . harps stringed instruments tambourines sistrums and cymbals
verses.literalPt: E Davi, e toda a casa de Israel, festejavam perante o SENHOR, com toda a sorte de instrumentos de pau de faia, como também com harpas, e com saltérios, e com tamboris, e com pandeiros, e com címbalos.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־ גֹּ֣רֶן נָכ֑וֹן וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח עֻזָּ֜א אֶל־ אֲר֤וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ וַיֹּ֣אחֶז בּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י שָׁמְט֖וּ הַבָּקָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḏ- gō·ren nā·ḵō·wn way·yiš·laḥ ‘uz·zā ’el- ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·ḥez bōw kî šā·mə·ṭū hab·bā·qār
verses.literal: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark of God because the oxen had stumbled
verses.literalPt: E, chegando à eira de Nacom, estendeu Uzá a mão à arca de Deus, e pegou nela; porque os bois a deixavam pender.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּעֻזָּ֔ה וַיַּכֵּ֥הוּ שָׁ֛ם הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עַל־ הַשַּׁ֑ל וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ Yah·weh bə·‘uz·zāh way·yak·kê·hū šām hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al- haš·šal way·yā·māṯ šām ‘im ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: And the anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah and God struck him down on the spot for his irreverence and he died there beside the ark of God
verses.literalPt: Então a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra Uzá, e Deus o feriu ali por esta imprudência; e morreu ali junto à arca de Deus.

verses.original: וַיִּ֣חַר לְדָוִ֔ד עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּרַ֧ץ יְהוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּעֻזָּ֑ה וַיִּקְרָ֞א לַמָּק֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ פֶּ֣רֶץ עֻזָּ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar lə·ḏā·wiḏ ‘al ’ă·šer pā·raṣ Yah·weh pe·reṣ bə·‘uz·zāh way·yiq·rā lam·mā·qō·wm ha·hū pe·reṣ ‘uz·zāh ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Then David became angry because the LORD had burst forth . . . against Uzzah So he named that place Perez-uzzah as it is called to this day
verses.literalPt: E Davi se contristou, porque o SENHOR abrira rotura em Uzá; e chamou àquele lugar Perez-Uzá, até ao dia de hoje.

verses.original: וַיִּרָ֥א דָוִ֛ד אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֵ֛יךְ יָב֥וֹא אֵלַ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·rā ḏā·wiḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·yō·mer ’êḵ yā·ḇō·w ’ê·lay ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh
verses.literal: That day David feared the LORD and asked How can the ark of the LORD ever come to me
verses.literalPt: E temeu Davi ao SENHOR naquele dia; e disse: Como virá a mim a arca do SENHOR?

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ אָבָ֣ה דָוִ֗ד לְהָסִ֥יר אֵלָ֛יו אֶת־ אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיַּטֵּ֣הוּ דָוִ֔ד בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־ אֱד֖וֹם הַגִּתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’ā·ḇāh ḏā·wiḏ lə·hā·sîr ’ê·lāw ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh ‘al- ‘îr dā·wiḏ way·yaṭ·ṭê·hū ḏā·wiḏ bêṯ ‘ō·ḇêḏ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm hag·git·tî
verses.literal: So he was unwilling to move . . . the ark of the LORD to the City of David instead, he took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite
verses.literalPt: E não quis Davi retirar para junto de si a arca do SENHOR, à cidade de Davi; mas Davi a fez levar à casa de Obede-Edom, o giteu.

verses.original: וַיֵּשֶׁב֩ אֲר֨וֹן יְהוָ֜ה בֵּ֣ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם הַגִּתִּ֖י שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh bêṯ ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm hag·git·tî šə·lō·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm way·ḇā·reḵ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm wə·’eṯ- kāl- bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Thus the ark of the LORD remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite for three months and the LORD blessed him and all his household
verses.literalPt: E ficou a arca do SENHOR em casa de Obede-Edom, o giteu, três meses; e abençoou o SENHOR a Obede-Edom, e a toda a sua casa.

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֗ד לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִד֮ לֵאמֹר֒ בֵּרַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־ בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֤ד אֱדֹם֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וַיַּעַל֩ אֶת־ אֲר֨וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים מִבֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם עִ֥יר דָּוִ֖ד בְּשִׂמְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yug·gaḏ lam·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ lê·mōr bê·raḵ Yah·weh ’eṯ- bêṯ ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw ba·‘ă·ḇūr ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yê·leḵ dā·wiḏ way·ya·‘al ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm mib·bêṯ ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·ḏōm ‘îr dā·wiḏ bə·śim·ḥāh
verses.literal: Now it was reported to King David . . . The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that belongs to him because of the ark of God So David went and had the ark of God brought up from the house of Obed-edom into the City of David with rejoicing
verses.literalPt: Então avisaram a Davi, dizendo: Abençoou o SENHOR a casa de Obede-Edom, e tudo quanto tem, por causa da arca de Deus; foi pois Davi, e trouxe a arca de Deus para cima, da casa de Obede-Edom, à cidade de Davi, com alegria.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּ֧י צָעֲד֛וּ נֹשְׂאֵ֥י אֲרוֹן־ יְהוָ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֣ה צְעָדִ֑ים וַיִּזְבַּ֥ח שׁ֖וֹר וּמְרִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî ṣā·‘ă·ḏū nō·śə·’ê ’ă·rō·wn- Yah·weh šiš·šāh ṣə·‘ā·ḏîm way·yiz·baḥ šō·wr ū·mə·rî
verses.literal: When those carrying the ark of the LORD had advanced six paces he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, quando os que levavam a arca do SENHOR tinham dado seis passos, sacrificava bois e carneiros cevados.

verses.original: וְדָוִ֛ד מְכַרְכֵּ֥ר בְּכָל־ עֹ֖ז לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְדָוִ֕ד חָג֖וּר אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wiḏ mə·ḵar·kêr bə·ḵāl ‘ōz lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·ḏā·wiḏ ḥā·ḡūr ’ê·p̄ō·wḏ bāḏ
verses.literal: And David wearing a linen ephod danced with all his might before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E Davi saltava com todas as suas forças diante do SENHOR; e estava Davi cingido de um éfode de linho.

verses.original: וְדָוִד֙ וְכָל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מַעֲלִ֖ים אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֑ה בִּתְרוּעָ֖ה וּבְק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wiḏ wə·ḵāl bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ma·‘ă·lîm ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh biṯ·rū·‘āh ū·ḇə·qō·wl šō·w·p̄ār
verses.literal: while he and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting and the sounding of the ram’s horn
verses.literalPt: Assim subindo, levavam Davi e todo o Israel a arca do SENHOR, com júbilo, e ao som das trombetas.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה בָּ֖א עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וּמִיכַ֨ל בַּת־ שָׁא֜וּל נִשְׁקְפָ֣ה׀ בְּעַ֣ד הַחַלּ֗וֹן וַתֵּ֨רֶא אֶת־ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ מְפַזֵּ֤ז וּמְכַרְכֵּר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתִּ֥בֶז ל֖וֹ בְּלִבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh bā ‘îr dā·wiḏ ū·mî·ḵal baṯ- šā·’ūl niš·qə·p̄āh bə·‘aḏ ha·ḥal·lō·wn wat·tê·re ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ mə·p̄az·zêz ū·mə·ḵar·kêr lip̄·nê Yah·weh wat·ti·ḇez lōw bə·lib·bāh
verses.literal: As the ark of the LORD was entering the City of David Saul’s daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD and she despised him in her heart
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, entrando a arca do SENHOR na cidade de Davi, Mical, a filha de Saul, estava olhando pela janela; e, vendo ao rei Davi, que ia bailando e saltando diante do SENHOR, o desprezou no seu coração.

verses.original: וַיָּבִ֜אוּ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֗ה וַיַּצִּ֤גוּ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּמְקוֹמ֔וֹ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָטָה־ ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑ד וַיַּ֨עַל דָּוִ֥ד עֹל֛וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וּשְׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇi·’ū ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh way·yaṣ·ṣi·ḡū ’ō·ṯōw bim·qō·w·mōw bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·’ō·hel ’ă·šer nā·ṭāh- lōw dā·wiḏ way·ya·‘al dā·wiḏ ‘ō·lō·wṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh ū·šə·lā·mîm
verses.literal: So they brought the ark of the LORD and set it in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it Then David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E introduzindo a arca do SENHOR, a puseram no seu lugar, na tenda que Davi lhe armara; e ofereceu Davi holocaustos e ofertas pacíficas perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיְכַ֣ל דָּוִ֔ד מֵהַעֲל֥וֹת הָעוֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם בְּשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal dā·wiḏ mê·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ hā·‘ō·w·lāh wə·haš·šə·lā·mîm way·ḇā·reḵ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām bə·šêm Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: When David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and peace offerings he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of Hosts
verses.literalPt: E acabando Davi de oferecer os holocaustos e ofertas pacíficas, abençoou o povo em nome do SENHOR dos Exércitos.

verses.original: וַיְחַלֵּ֨ק לְכָל־ הָעָ֜ם לְכָל־ הֲמ֣וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְמֵאִ֣ישׁ וְעַד־ אִשָּׁה֒ לְאִ֗ישׁ חַלַּ֥ת לֶ֙חֶם֙ אַחַ֔ת וְאֶשְׁפָּ֣ר אֶחָ֔ד וַאֲשִׁישָׁ֖ה אֶחָ֑ת וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥal·lêq lə·ḵāl hā·‘ām lə·ḵāl hă·mō·wn yiś·rā·’êl lə·mê·’îš wə·‘aḏ- ’iš·šāh lə·’îš ḥal·laṯ le·ḥem ’a·ḥaṯ wə·’eš·pār ’e·ḥāḏ wa·’ă·šî·šāh ’e·ḥāṯ way·yê·leḵ kāl- hā·‘ām ’îš lə·ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then he distributed to every . . . man and woman among the multitude of Israel a loaf of bread a date cake and a raisin cake And all the people departed each to his own home
verses.literalPt: E repartiu a todo o povo, e a toda a multidão de Israel, desde os homens até às mulheres, a cada um, um bolo de pão, e um bom pedaço de carne, e um frasco de vinho; então retirou-se todo o povo, cada um para sua casa,

verses.original: וַיָּ֥שָׁב דָּוִ֖ד לְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶת־ בֵּית֑וֹ וַתֵּצֵ֞א מִיכַ֤ל בַּת־ שָׁאוּל֙ לִקְרַ֣את דָּוִ֔ד וַתֹּ֗אמֶר מַה־ נִּכְבַּ֨ד הַיּ֜וֹם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִגְלָ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ לְעֵינֵ֨י אַמְה֣וֹת עֲבָדָ֔יו כְּהִגָּל֥וֹת נִגְל֖וֹת אַחַ֥ד הָרֵקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ dā·wiḏ lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- bê·ṯōw wat·tê·ṣê mî·ḵal baṯ- šā·’ūl liq·raṯ dā·wiḏ wat·tō·mer mah- niḵ·baḏ hay·yō·wm me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer niḡ·lāh hay·yō·wm lə·‘ê·nê ’am·hō·wṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw kə·hig·gā·lō·wṯ niḡ·lō·wṯ ’a·ḥaḏ hā·rê·qîm
verses.literal: When David returned home to bless his own household Saul’s . . . daughter Michal came out to meet him How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today she said He has uncovered himself today in the sight of the maidservants of his subjects like a vulgar person would do . . .
verses.literalPt: E, voltando Davi para abençoar a sua casa, Mical, a filha de Saul, saiu a encontrar-se com Davi, e disse: Quão honrado foi o rei de Israel, descobrindo-se hoje aos olhos das servas de seus servos, como sem pejo se descobre qualquer dos vadios.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִד֮ אֶל־ מִיכַל֒ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּֽחַר־ בִּ֤י מֵֽאָבִיךְ֙ וּמִכָּל־ בֵּית֔וֹ לְצַוֺּ֨ת אֹתִ֥י נָגִ֛יד עַל־ עַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשִׂחַקְתִּ֖י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- mî·ḵal lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ă·šer bā·ḥar- bî mê·’ā·ḇîḵ ū·mik·kāl- bê·ṯōw lə·ṣaw·wōṯ ’ō·ṯî nā·ḡîḏ ‘al- ‘am Yah·weh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·śi·ḥaq·tî lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: But David said to Michal I was dancing before the LORD who chose me over your father and all his house when He appointed me ruler over the LORD’s . . . people Israel I will celebrate before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Disse, porém, Davi a Mical: Perante o SENHOR, que me escolheu preferindo-me a teu pai, e a toda a sua casa, mandando-me que fosse soberano sobre o povo do SENHOR, sobre Israel, perante o SENHOR tenho me alegrado.

verses.original: וּנְקַלֹּ֤תִי עוֹד֙ מִזֹּ֔את וְהָיִ֥יתִי שָׁפָ֖ל בְּעֵינָ֑י וְעִם־ הָֽאֲמָהוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתְּ עִמָּ֖ם אִכָּבֵֽדָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·qal·lō·ṯî ‘ō·wḏ miz·zōṯ wə·hā·yî·ṯî šā·p̄āl bə·‘ê·nāy wə·‘im- hā·’ă·mā·hō·wṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·mart ‘im·mām ’ik·kā·ḇê·ḏāh
verses.literal: and I will humiliate . . . and humble myself even more than this Yet I will be honored by the maidservants of whom you have spoken . . .
verses.literalPt: E ainda mais do que isto me envilecerei, e me humilharei aos meus olhos; mas das servas, de quem falaste, delas serei honrado.

verses.original: וּלְמִיכַל֙ בַּת־ שָׁא֔וּל לֹֽא־ הָ֥יָה לָ֖הּ יָ֑לֶד עַ֖ד י֥וֹם מוֹתָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·mî·ḵal baṯ- šā·’ūl lō- hā·yāh lāh yā·leḏ ‘aḏ yō·wm mō·w·ṯāh
verses.literal: And Michal the daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death
verses.literalPt: E Mical, a filha de Saul, não teve filhos, até o dia da sua morte.
